name: The Platinum Card® from American Express Exclusively for Charles Schwab

localized_names.en: The Platinum Card® from American Express Exclusively for Charles Schwab

apr.notes: APR for Pay Over Time: 19.49% to 28.49% variable. Cash Advance APR: 28.74%. Penalty APR: 29.99%. Variable APRs will not exceed 29.99%. Accurate as of 07/23/26.

credit_required.notes: Good to excellent credit recommended. Must maintain an eligible Schwab brokerage account (Schwab One, Schwab General Brokerage, or Schwab Traditional/Roth/Rollover IRA).

base_rate.description: 1x point per dollar on all other eligible purchases

categories.label: Flights booked directly with airlines or through Amex Travel (up to $500K/year)
Prepaid hotels booked through Amex Travel

rewards.redemption_notes: Membership Rewards points transfer to airline/hotel partners OR redeem via Invest with Rewards: deposit into eligible Schwab brokerage account at 1.1 cents per point (10,000 points = $110). Schwab Appreciation Bonus: $100 statement credit with $250K-$1M qualifying Schwab holdings, $200 with $1M-$10M.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 80,000 Membership Rewards points after spending $12,000 in eligible purchases within the first 6 months of Card Membership.

benefits.title: Global Lounge Collection
benefits.description: Unlimited complimentary access to 1,500+ airport lounges worldwide including Centurion Lounges, Delta Sky Clubs (when flying Delta), Priority Pass, Plaza Premium, and Escape Lounges.

benefits.title: $120 Uber One Credit
benefits.description: Up to $120 in statement credits per calendar year on Uber One membership fees. Enrollment required.

benefits.title: $200 Airline Fee Credit
benefits.description: Up to $200 in statement credits per calendar year for incidental airline fees from one selected qualifying airline. Enrollment required.

benefits.title: $200 Uber Cash
benefits.description: $15 Uber Cash each month plus $20 in December ($200/year). Must add eligible Card as payment method in Uber account.

benefits.title: $219 CLEAR+ Credit
benefits.description: Up to $219 in statement credits per calendar year for CLEAR+ Membership. Enrollment required.

benefits.title: $300 Digital Entertainment Credit
benefits.description: Up to $25/month ($300/year) on Disney+, ESPN, Hulu, NYT, Paramount+, Peacock, WSJ, YouTube. Enrollment required.

benefits.title: $300 Equinox Credit
benefits.description: Up to $300/year on U.S. eligible Equinox memberships or Equinox+ subscription. Enrollment required.

benefits.title: $300 lululemon Credit
benefits.description: Up to $300/year on eligible lululemon purchases. Enrollment required.

benefits.title: $400 Resy Credit
benefits.description: Up to $100/quarter ($400/year) on eligible dining purchases through Resy. Enrollment required.

benefits.title: $600 Hotel Credit
benefits.description: Up to $200 on Fine Hotels + Resorts bookings and up to $400 on The Hotel Collection bookings (2+ night stays) through Amex Travel.

benefits.title: Invest with Rewards
benefits.description: Redeem Membership Rewards points for deposits into eligible Schwab brokerage account at 1.1 cents per point.

benefits.title: Schwab Appreciation Bonus
benefits.description: $100 statement credit if Qualifying Schwab Holdings are $250K-$1M, or $200 if $1M-$10M, measured on approval and each anniversary.

benefits.title: Fine Hotels + Resorts Program
benefits.description: Complimentary benefits at 1,000+ luxury hotels when booking through Amex FHR, including room upgrades, late checkout, daily breakfast, and property credits.

benefits.title: TSA PreCheck/Global Entry Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit every 4 years for either up to $85 TSA PreCheck or $120 Global Entry application fee.

lounge_access.program: Global Lounge Collection (Centurion, Delta Sky Club, Priority Pass, Plaza Premium, Escape Lounges)
lounge_access.notes: Unlimited complimentary access to 1,500+ airport lounges worldwide

travel_perks.hotel_status: Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite status and Hilton Honors Gold status
other: $200 airline fee credit (select one qualifying airline)
Invest with Rewards at 1.1 cents/point to Schwab brokerage
Schwab Appreciation Bonus ($100-$200 based on holdings)

notes: The Platinum Card from American Express Exclusively for Charles Schwab. Annual fee $895. Name and welcome offer re-verified 2026-07-25 against the Amex application offer terms: current standard offer is 80,000 Membership Rewards points after $12,000 spend in 6 months (the previously listed elevated 150,000-point offer expired 7/8/2026). No standalone /card/ product page exists for this partner card; the Amex terms/disclosures application page is the official source. network_tier is none for Amex.
